name: arrester
description: Après un blocage (hook, règle, mode auto ou ton refus), empêche Claude de contourner l'interdiction par un autre outil et lui dit de s'arrêter pour te demander

response.title: Response to a suspected workaround
response.description: deny refuses the call at once with a reason Claude reads. hold asks you in a dialog and waits for your answer; a claude -p run has no one to ask, so the call is refused.

block_minutes.title: Minutes a block stays open
block_minutes.description: How long Arrester watches after a guard blocks a call, counted from the block or from its last target or retry match. A guard or opaque match alone does not extend it.
